free_tier.stated: Quoted: "GTS is currently available to researchers from the European network research community with an endorsement from their local NREN". Quoted on cost: "There are no costs, but there are quotas in place on how many resources you can use."

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: Nothing for an unaffiliated individual. For someone with an NREN endorsement it would be free multi-node testbed compute, which the free public clouds do not offer at any price.

limits.value: No cost, but entry needs an endorsement from a national research and education network plus a project description, and quotas are set by the operator, so a person with no NREN affiliation cannot request a VM.
